correctness.rationale: The full 48-element automorphism group is enumerated from graph adjacency; 195 nonempty independent faces and all 630 barycentric chain orbits are recomputed. All 299 listed geometric free-face pairs are checked against every remaining cell, leaving a connected 7-vertex, 15-edge, 10-triangle closed two-manifold with Euler characteristic two and circular vertex links. The classification of compact surfaces gives \(S^2\). Separate signed Lefschetz traces corroborate the Euler count.

value.rationale: The Franklin graph is the canonical symmetric cubic graph associated with the Klein-bottle six-color exception. The ordinary orbit-space homotopy type under its entire noncyclic automorphism group is a natural invariant, and a sphere-level classification is stronger than Euler characteristic or rational homology ranks. The explicit small closed-surface core and replayable 299-pair geometric collapse are reusable structural evidence, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
